headline: Clean: Purple Account and Silver Plus Account are the only products that meet every stated need, and the check deposit is fully scripted.
solution_check: Checking: tabulated all personal checking products. Only Purple has a multi-currency wallet (purple_001 "Multi-currency wallet | Yes"), 0% foreign transaction fee, $30 global ATM rebates, and a $3,750 waiver within the customer's $3-5k. Bluest also has rebates and $0 foreign ATM fees but needs a $112,500 daily balance. Savings: Silver Plus has 15 free withdrawals, $2,500 minimum, daily compounding, ATM rebates up to 25, a 0.025% relationship bonus, and Tier 1 3.0%. Silver allows 10 withdrawals, Green 8 and has no relationship bonus, Gold needs $10,000, and Bronze allows 6. The existing Green checking (account 05, opened 11/10/2022) satisfies the 14-day rule, and deposit_check_3847 into the new savings 7e48bf3b0589cfad for $1,500 matches the gold.
prior_note: Prior rated this clean; still clean.
notes: Grading-model facts re-checked against the v1.0.1 snapshot (evaluator_env.py, build.py _derive_read_log_allowlist, tools.py call_discoverable_agent_tool/call_discoverable_user_tool, tasks.py compare_with_tool_call) and the verified scorer (_verified_db_match in the working repo, commit 4cb3191): all hold as stated. reward_basis is ['DB'] only. Replays used PYTHONPATH=<snapshot>/src, retrieval_variant='grep_only' (tools identical to default 'alltools', which needs an OpenAI key to build), and the gold-derived read_log_allowlist; scratch scripts in scratchpad/vs2_review_054/ (harness.py, apy.py). Account IDs are hashes of user_id:account_type:account_class, so the gold IDs follow from the class strings 'Purple Account' and 'Silver Plus Account', which match the 'ending with Account' rule in general_001/002. The customer's "3-4 times a week, sometimes more" can exceed Silver Plus's 15 free withdrawals, but no other product within $7,000 allows more. The user's call is logged per argument set; numbers are parsed as floats, so 1500 and 1500.0 match.
